visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Button stays disabled
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The Save button should turn on when a name is typed, but it never does. The script sets the property to the wrong value.
visualizerParams.buggyCode:
<input id="name" placeholder="Name">
<button id="save" disabled>Save</button>
<script>
  var who = document.getElementById('name');
  var save = document.getElementById('save');
  who.addEventListener('input', function () {
    save.disabled = who.value !== '';
  });
</script>

solution.code:
<input id="name" placeholder="Name">
<button id="save" disabled>Save</button>
<script>
  var who = document.getElementById('name');
  var save = document.getElementById('save');
  who.addEventListener('input', function () {
    save.disabled = who.value === '';
  });
</script>
solution.explanation: The button must be disabled when the field is empty. The test was the wrong way round: not empty gave disabled true. Say what you want in words first: disabled when the value is empty.
